title: Our best tips for using the iPhone Duo

claims.claim: The Duo is an entirely new kind of iPhone.

evidence.quote: The Duo is an entirely new kind of iPhone

claims.claim: You can set orientation lock on each screen of the iPhone Duo independently.

evidence.quote: You can set orientation lock on each screen independently

claims.claim: You can change the volume controls setting on the iPhone Duo via Settings, Sounds & Haptics, and Fixed Position Volume Controls.

evidence.quote: Go to Settings > Sounds & Haptics > Fixed Position Volume Controls and toggle it off.

claims.claim: You can tap the unified Wi-Fi and battery status icon on the iPhone Duo to bring up Control Center.

evidence.quote: just tap the new, unified Wi-Fi / battery status icon. This will fully reveal the Control Center
there’s another way to pull up the Control Center — just tap the new, unified Wi-Fi / battery status icon. This will fully reveal the Control Center

claims.claim: John Ternus is the Apple CEO mentioned in the text.
MagSafe PopSocket can be used with the iPhone Duo.

evidence.quote: The MagSafe PopSocket I’ve been using with the Duo has been more than strong enough to support the phone’s weight.
